sanctity--noun.def: The state of being holy or of deserving great respect.
sanctity--noun.ex: The law defends the sanctity of the home.

unplug--verb.def: To disconnect a machine from the electricity.
unplug--verb.ex: Unplug the heater before you leave.

subordinate--noun.def: A person of lower rank who works under another.
subordinate--noun.ex: He treats every subordinate with respect.

enviable--adv.def: In a way that others would like to have.
enviable--adv.ex: She is enviable calm under pressure.

sketchbook--noun.def: A book of blank pages used for drawing.
sketchbook--noun.exTr: Her yere bir eskiz defteri taşıyor.

possessor--noun.def: A person who owns or holds something.
possessor--noun.ex: The possessor of the ticket wins.

prohibitive--adj.def: So expensive that it stops people buying.
prohibitive--adj.ex: The cost is prohibitive for families.

prohibitively--adv.def: To a degree that prevents something.

proliferate--verb.ex: Small shops proliferated after the change.
proliferate--verb.exTr: Değişiklikten sonra küçük dükkânlar hızla çoğaldı.

prolifically--adv.ex: She wrote prolifically in old age.

provocatively--adv.def: In a way meant to cause anger or debate.

quip--verb.def: To say something clever and amusing.
quip--verb.ex: He quipped that the coffee was stronger than him.
quip--verb.exTr: Kahvenin kendisinden güçlü olduğuna dair espri yaptı.

readable--adj.def: Easy to read, or enjoyable to read.

recessive--adj.def: Said of a gene whose effect shows only in some cases.
recessive--adj.ex: Blue eyes come from a recessive gene.
recessive--adj.exTr: Mavi gözler çekinik bir genden geliyor.

recognizably--adv.def: In a way that is easy to know again.

refurbish--verb.def: To clean and repair a building to make it modern.

refurbishment--noun.def: The work of repairing and improving a building.

remorsefully--adv.def: In a way that shows deep regret.

remorseless--adj.def: Showing no regret, or never stopping.
remorseless--adj.ex: The remorseless rain flooded the fields.

repellant--noun.def: A substance that keeps insects away.

repellant--adj.def: Driving something away, or very unpleasant.

repertory--noun.def: A theatre company that performs several plays in turn.

robustly--adv.def: In a strong and determined way.

rudiments--noun.def: The most basic facts or skills of a subject.
rudiments--noun.ex: She learned the rudiments of Arabic.

salivate--verb.def: To produce more liquid in the mouth, usually from hunger.

scornful--adj.def: Showing that you think something is worthless.

scornfully--adv.def: In a way that shows no respect.

scrutinize--verb.exTr: Denetçiler her fişi didik didik inceledi.

sedentary--adj.def: Involving a lot of sitting and little exercise.
sedentary--adj.ex: A sedentary job harms the back.
sedentary--adj.exTr: Hareketsiz bir iş sırta zarar veriyor.

sentimentally--adv.def: In a way ruled by feeling rather than reason.
sentimentally--adv.ex: He speaks sentimentally of his village.

shortlist--verb.def: To choose a few candidates from a larger group.

shortlist--noun.def: The small group of candidates chosen for final selection.
shortlist--noun.ex: Her name is on the shortlist.

slackly--adv.def: Not tightly, or without proper effort.

smugly--adv.def: In a way that is too pleased with yourself.
smugly--adv.ex: He smiled smugly at the result.

socialization--noun.def: The process of learning to live within a society.

somberly--adv.def: In a serious and sad way.
somberly--adv.ex: He spoke somberly of the losses.

specification--noun.def: A detailed description of how something must be made.

staccato--adj.ex: He spoke in a staccato voice.

startlingly--adv.def: In a surprising and slightly shocking way.

stressfully--adv.def: In a way that causes worry and pressure.

stuffily--adv.def: Without fresh air, or in a very formal manner.
stuffily--adv.exTr: Oldukça resmi bir biçimde cevap verdi.

stuffiness--noun.def: The state of having no fresh air.
stuffiness--noun.ex: The stuffiness of the hall tired us.

stylistic--adj.def: Relating to the style of writing or of art.

succulently--adv.def: In a way that is full of juice and pleasant to eat.

superficially--adv.def: Only on the surface, without going deep.
superficially--adv.ex: The two cases are superficially alike.

sustainably--adv.def: In a way that can continue without harming the environment.

synthetically--adv.def: By a chemical process rather than naturally.

tactfully--adv.def: In a way that avoids upsetting people.

tastebud--noun.def: One of the tiny parts of the tongue that sense flavour.

tautly--adv.def: Stretched tight, or with visible tension.

tediously--adv.def: In a way that is boring because it lasts too long.

tedium--noun.def: The dullness of something that goes on too long.

temperamentally--adv.def: In terms of a person's natural character.
temperamentally--adv.ex: He is temperamentally unsuited to the job.
temperamentally--adv.exTr: Mizaç olarak bu işe uygun değil.

transfix--verb.def: To make someone unable to move because of interest or fear.

turn-to--verb.def: To go to someone for help or advice.
turn-to--verb.ex: She had nobody to turn to.

unassisted--adj.ex: He walked unassisted after a month.

unconvincing--adj.def: Not able to make people believe it.

unconvincingly--adv.def: In a way that fails to persuade.
unconvincingly--adv.exTr: İnandırıcı olmayan bir biçimde inkâr etti.

unenviable--adj.def: Difficult and unpleasant, so that nobody wants it.

unenviably--adv.def: In a way nobody would want.

uniformity--noun.def: The state of being the same everywhere.

uninspiring--adj.def: Dull and not making anyone enthusiastic.

unmanageable--adj.def: Too difficult to control or to deal with.

unmusical--adj.def: Not pleasant to hear, or having no ear for music.

unmusically--adv.def: In a way that does not sound pleasant.

unreliably--adv.def: In a way that cannot be depended on.

unscathing--adj.def: Leaving no harm behind, a rare form of unscathed.
unscathing--adj.ex: The fire passed unscathing over the stone.
unscathing--adj.exTr: Yangın taşın üstünden zarar vermeden geçti.

unsettle--verb.def: To make someone feel worried and uncertain.

unsustainably--adv.def: In a way that cannot continue without harm.

venerate--verb.def: To respect someone deeply, often for religious reasons.
venerate--verb.ex: The town venerates its old teacher.

verandah--noun.def: An open roofed area along the side of a house.

verve--noun.def: Energy and enthusiasm in what you do.

victoriously--adv.def: In the manner of someone who has won.

voraciously--adv.def: In a way that consumes a great deal.

washtub--noun.def: A large round container used for washing clothes.
washtub--noun.ex: The old washtub stands in the yard.

wizened--adj.ex: A wizened old man opened the gate.
wizened--adj.exTr: Buruşuk yüzlü yaşlı bir adam kapıyı açtı.

wryly--adv.def: With dry humour about something unpleasant.
wryly--adv.exTr: Hatasını buruk bir gülümsemeyle kabul etti.
